after_snippet:
import redis
from typing import get_type_hints

# In 8.0.0, overload pattern provides distinct return types
# Sync client.get() now properly typed as returning Union[str, bytes, None]
# instead of Union[Awaitable[...], Union[str, bytes, None]]
client = redis.Redis()
hints = get_type_hints(client.get)
assert True
before_snippet:
import redis
from typing import get_type_hints

# In 7.4.1, methods return Union[Awaitable, Any] for async compatibility
client = redis.Redis()
# Type checking in 7.4.1 saw combined types, static analysis tools had false positives
# This is primarily a type-checking change, runtime works the same
hints = get_type_hints(client.get)
assert True
title: Type hints now use @overload pattern with separate sync/async return types instead of Union[Awaitable[T], T]
